subject.title: fix(gateway): fail fast on missing local probe auth

question: Should a local gateway configured for required auth but unable to resolve its configured credential fail immediately, or should status preserve the shipped probe attempt and report the credential diagnostic alongside it?
rationale: Both outcomes are technically implementable, but they intentionally choose different upgrade behavior for existing operator setups; repository policy treats fallback removal and stricter auth behavior as a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Preserve the shipped probe by default
options.body: Keep probing local loopback as today and attach the unresolved-credential warning, retaining existing diagnostic behavior while improving operator visibility.

options.title: Adopt fail-fast intentionally
options.body: Approve the synthetic auth failure as the new default and require explicit upgrade/recovery documentation and coverage for affected existing configurations.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Retain current probe behavior and decline this change if the misleading-error tradeoff is not worth altering the established fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve the shipped probe by default
recommendation.body: Keep probing local loopback as today and attach the unresolved-credential warning, retaining existing diagnostic behavior while improving operator visibility.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline identifies steipete as a gateway/auth discussion participant, and this is a default-policy choice rather than a mechanical fix.
